title: Walk That Weaves
idiom: Klee-like gouache, a walker whose path becomes woven cloth
hero_prompt: Gouache painting in the manner of Paul Klee, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a lone walker, a man with a staff, crossing a rolling hilly landscape, and the path behind him is a single bright thread that loops and crosses the threads of earlier walks, weaving the hills into a loose patterned cloth as he goes. Small squares of warm colour, rust, ochre, teal and plum.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a teal ground, no shading or gradients: a small walking figure with a staff, trailing a single thread that loops back into a woven knot behind him. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
